what: The disagreements docs/COORDINATION.md carries today, recorded rather than corrected. scripts/check-board.py fails on anything not in this list, and fails again on any entry here the board no longer earns.
why: The board has one writer. A lane that quietly corrected it would delete the evidence that the check works, and would put a worker's opinion into a document that records the coordinator's. So the findings from the first run are written down, with what each one costs to close, and the coordinator strikes them off.

closed.how: 34 prompt headings retired from `(UNASSIGNED — paste into a fresh CLI session)` to `(RUN — kept as the record of what the lane was asked for; do not paste it)`. The prompt text is kept: it is the record of what each lane was actually told, which is what makes a delta sheet checkable. Only the invitation is gone.
W41's row now records PR #139 and points at docs/foreign-runtime.md. Its prompt heading was retired in the same pass, because correcting the row is what makes the prompt claim fire for it.
